title: CIMRAG: CIM-AWARE DOMAIN-ADAPTIVE AND NOISE-RESILIENT RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION FOR EDGE-BASED LLMS
reasoning: The paper is focused on technical optimizations for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in edge-based Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically addressing hardware noise and domain adaptability in Computing-in-Memory (CiM) architectures. There is no component related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
